svg.title: Complete control-board wiring — Mosquito Laser Killer
svg.desc: Consolidated pin-to-pin interconnection map for the Raspberry Pi 5, two SN74AHCT125N buffers, two MCP4922 DACs, 74HC123 one-shot, SN74HC08 AND gate, arm and E-stop sense circuits, cameras, galvo drivers, laser driver, and power and safety modules.
svg.text: Complete control-board wiring — Raspberry Pi 5 + interface board
Consolidated interconnection sheet. Pin numbers are physical header / PDIP pins. HARDWARE_WIRING.md remains the source of truth.
CLASS 4 LASER • DO NOT ENERGIZE: missing/unverified parts are outlined red. Mains assembly must be designed, built, and inspected by a qualified person.
5 V LOGIC / INTERFACE BOARD — soldered final assembly, not a permanent breadboard
Pi is powered separately by USB-C; it is NOT on K1.
+5 V FROM PI HEADER • survives E-stop
COMMON SIGNAL GND • star-bond to galvo COM and 12 V−
+3.3 V FROM PI HEADER • sense / CS pull-ups only
ON HAND • untraceable brand • threshold-test per §9.4
ON HAND • untraceable brand • separate package
pins 4,5,12 outputs open • measure pulse width (Hitachi: t_W = R·C ≈ 220 ms)
E-STOP POLE 2 — GPIO25 • active LOW / fail-safe
Zener cathode/band at junction; anode to GND • released ≈2.48 V
ARM + DOOR CONTACT 2 — hard 12 V cut + GPIO24 sense
12 V_K1 → ARM switch → DOOR contact 2 NC → laser driver +VIN
sense junction → 3 kΩ ∥ 100 nF ∥ BZX55C3V3 → GND; cathode/band at node • armed ≈2.77 V
POWER + SAFETY CONTACTOR — functional map only; use drawing 2 for mains terminals and segregation
per local rules • on hand, not built
+15 / COM / −15 three-conductor power harness to BOTH galvo drivers
fan upstream; driver branch through ARM + DOOR 2
K1 LATCHING COIL CIRCUIT • all parts / ratings require qualified selection
post-isolator A → E-STOP pole 1 NC → DOOR contact 1 NC → (START NO ∥ K1 AUX NO) → K1 coil → conductor B
Releasing E-stop or closing door must NOT restart power; a deliberate START press is required.
COMMON SIGNAL REFERENCE — one central point
Pi/DAC/logic GND + galvo PSU COM + driver signal GND + 12 V−
PROTECTIVE EARTH — never switched, never fused • bond both PSU PE terminals, metal enclosure, laser chassis, galvo driver/head chassis
PE is a safety conductor; it is not interchangeable with logic GND.

Before either laser is connected: verify every part marking and pinout against its manufacturer datasheet; meter both sense nodes disconnected from the Pi; scope SPI at the DAC pins; scope all six fail-LOW / one-shot tests in HARDWARE_WIRING.md §9.4 and §11a.
